name: Browser
short_desc: Service: Shared Chromium for agents and apps, with a phone viewer for human handoffs (CAPTCHA, codes, logins).
author: Humanity Labs (packaging, handoff viewer); noVNC authors (MPL-2.0); the Chromium project
description: One shared headful Chromium (Debian package, on a virtual display) that DeFleur Video and other apps drive with Puppeteer or the Chrome DevTools Protocol at http://browser:9222 inside Runtipi, and that agents use through MCP. When a page needs a person (CAPTCHA, one-time code, login, consent, payment) the agent opens a private, expiring handoff link; the owner takes over the same live browser from a phone through a noVNC 1.3.0 viewer with Keyboard, Paste, Up and Down controls, then the agent resumes. Stop the app to turn it off.

form_fields.label: Wizard owner gateway Browser prefix (optional)
form_fields.hint: Owner-authenticated gateway app prefix, e.g. https://your-wizard.example/browser (not a direct CDP port). Default links are relative to /browser.
